faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.installQ: Do students need to install anything?
faq.installA: No. Strawie runs in any modern browser on a laptop or Chromebook. Python runs right in the page.
faq.accountsA: With a Google account, personal or school. If your school limits third-party apps, your admin may need to allow Strawie first.
faq.whoQ: Who can see a student's code?
faq.whoA: Homework and Solo copies are visible only to that student and their teacher. The shared lesson page is visible to the whole group.
faq.pythonA: Python 3 with the standard library, running in the browser. input() works. Code can't reach the internet or other people's files.
faq.ownQ: Can I write my own lessons and tests?
faq.ownA: Yes. Every lesson page and homework is yours to write. Tests can call a function or check what a program prints.
faq.languagesA: English and Russian. Kazakh is coming soon.
